messages:
Alex (docs): Noticed a user issue: the generate endpoint doc shows a single JSON response example. Our runtime actually sends SSE when stream=true. This trip-up is leading to bad client parsing errors.

Priya (eng-runtime): Yep that's on us. The server emits event: partial + event: done pairs, Content-Type: text/event-stream when stream=true. For stream=false you get application/json with the final object.

Ken (eng-ml): Can we standardize the example payloads? I'm seeing variety in the tests. Suggest we publish a minimal canonical SSE payload (partial/done) and a one-line migration snippet.

Maya (product): Users care about two things: how to consume SSE and how to get the old single-response behavior. Short, clear examples sell that.

Alex (docs): I'll open a tiny PR to replace the incorrect JSON example with: 1) curl SSE example (Accept: text/event-stream), 2) a tiny SSE sample showing two partial events + done, 3) example curl with stream=false that returns JSON, 4) 1-line migration note.

doc-ci-bot: Created PR alex/docs#1823 by Alex (docs) - https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1823

Priya (eng-runtime): Thanks. Can you include the exact event names we assert in tests: "partial" and "done"? Also make sure the data JSON includes "text" and "delta" fields. I'll add a test to the runtime suite to lock that shape.

Alex (docs): Will do. Draft samples (putting here so CI snippet tests can reference):

Alex (docs): ```bash
curl -N -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"redwood-7b","input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?stream=true
```

Alex (docs): ```
event: partial
data: {"text":"H","delta":"H"}

event: partial
data: {"text":"i","delta":"i"}

event: done
data: {"text":"Hi","delta":"","final":true}
```

Alex (docs): ```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"redwood-7b","input":"hi","stream":false}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# -> single JSON response with text field
```

Ken (eng-ml): Nice. Add one line: "If you previously parsed the body as a single JSON object, switch to consuming SSE events or set stream=false to get a non-streaming response."

Maya (product): For SDK docs, show two micro snippets: Node (attach listener) and Python (async for event in stream). Keep them 3-4 lines each.

Alex (docs): I'll add those in the PR under the streaming section and also update the Content-Type note (text/event-stream vs application/json). Assigning Priya for review.

Priya (eng-runtime): On it. I'll also add a tiny integration test that hits /generate?stream=true and asserts we see event names and the data shape. I'll post a link to the test PR after I push.

doc-ci-bot: Alex's PR updated with SSE examples and migration note.

Alex (docs): Thanks team. After merge I'll ping @sdk-owners to refresh language snippets in their READMEs.

Priya (eng-runtime): Thanks. One optional ask: include a short troubleshooting subsection that mentions common parser mistakes (e.g., treating "data:" lines as complete JSON without trimming).

Alex (docs): Good idea, adding that now. Will merge once Priya's review is green.

Priya (eng-runtime): Review complete, minor nit about spacing in the sample event block. LGTM otherwise.

Alex (docs): Fixed spacing, merged PR. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1823/commits/7f9c

Maya (product): :tada: Thanks for the quick turnaround.
